card.title: Hope Is Evidence
card.instruction: Treat every small kindness, coincidence, or improvement as undeniable proof that the best possible outcome is gathering momentum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The gallery thanked me for my paintings. Help me choose glasses for opening night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the automatic reply. Don't spend our rent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They're expecting enough interest to automate. We should buy in bulk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll lend you six glasses. That's all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our first sponsor. I'll put your name on the invitations.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats a gallery acknowledgment as an opening, A3 turns automation into expected demand, and A5 turns six loaned glasses into sponsorship.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's automatic-reply correction causes A3's demand theory; B4's bounded loan gives A5 a first-sponsor claim and invitation plan.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects shared rent and B4 offers limited practical help rather than endorsing the assumed exhibition.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's small kindness as decisive evidence that the successful opening is gathering support.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's first-sponsor label is earned by B4's six-glass loan.
